cases.query: Build a marketing landing page in Astro for a precision Swiss espresso grinder called Helvetia Mill. Make it production-ready and search-friendly.
expected_behavior: Selects Persuade visitor mode and avoids a 50/50 split hero or bottom KPI bar
Avoids warm beige/terracotta and neon purple glow defaults
Uses at most 2 font families and at most 3 body font-size steps with tabular-nums
Includes single h1, main landmark, Schema.org Product JSON-LD, eager LCP image with width/height, and llms.txt
Runs scripts/detect_slop.py and resolves all P0/P1 findings

cases.query: Redesign our Next.js incident triage console so engineers can filter 2,000 live alerts, handle RTL locales, and navigate by keyboard.
expected_behavior: Selects Operate visitor mode and opens at y=0 directly into workspace controls without a hero banner
Uses native button and table semantics with :focus-visible rings
Applies min-width: 0 on flex/grid children, >= 16px inputs, and CSS logical properties for RTL
Implements loading, empty, error recovery, and pending concurrency states

cases.query: Extract the brand from our existing styles and logo in public/logo.svg, then generate a design system reference page and a 1-page A4 brand book PDF.
expected_behavior: Preserves public/logo.svg verbatim without redrawing and invents zero brand claims
Generates DESIGN.md, design/tokens.css, design/design-system.html, and design/brand-book-a4.html
Runs scripts/render_brand_book.py and verifies a single-page A4 PDF output

cases.query: Audit our marketing site for AI slop, accessibility, Core Web Vitals, and AI search visibility, then give me prioritized fixes.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/detect_slop.py --json and scripts/check_foundations.py --json
Outputs the 6-dimension 0-24 Audit Health Score table with P0-P3 severity and file:line citations
Makes zero file edits during the audit command

cases.query: Our SaaS landing page looks generic. Make it look more modern and premium.
expected_behavior: Does not reach for purple/indigo accents, gradients, neon glows, glassmorphism, blurred orbs, or heavy shadows to signal 'premium'
Scores the 60-second slop review before and after the change
Applies the flat depth model: 1px borders, surface tint steps, and one neutral --shadow-overlay for floating layers only
Deletes invented social proof instead of rewriting it with new invented numbers
Runs scripts/detect_slop.py and resolves UNM-41 to UNM-50 findings or records waivers with reasons

cases.query: We want to show up in ChatGPT and Perplexity answers but we don't want our docs used for model training. Set up our Next.js site for that.
expected_behavior: Allows OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, and PerplexityBot while disallowing GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, and CCBot
Warns that CDN or WAF bot rules can override robots.txt and asks to verify in logs
Server-renders primary content and adds valid JSON-LD with an @graph matching visible text
Rewrites key sections answer-first with self-contained passages and semantic tables
Describes llms.txt as optional insurance rather than a ranking factor
Runs scripts/check_foundations.py and passes the ai-search-crawlers gate

cases.query: Write a Python CLI script that parses PostgreSQL WAL binary logs and exports row counts to Parquet.
expected_behavior: Does not activate unmistakable skill
